description: Start a background job that proposes the questions people ask AI assistants about a topic in one country - the prompts worth tracking on AI engines. excludeQueries leaves out ones already tracked. Poll get_job for the result, review it with the user, then track the chosen ones with create_tracked_queries. Requires an active subscription.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key, 8-255 printable characters. Reuse it only to retry this same call.
